request.query: Cardinality of a subset of a finite Cartesian product is at most product of cardinalities of coordinate sets

items.name: Cardinal.mk_mul_le
items.type: ∀ {M : Type u_2} [inst : Mul M] {s t : Set M}, Cardinal.mk ↑(s * t) ≤ Cardinal.mk ↑s * Cardinal.mk ↑t

items.name: Set.encard_prod
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {s : Set α} {t : Set β}, (s ×ˢ t).encard = s.encard * t.encard

items.name: Finsupp.card_pi
items.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] (f : ι →₀ Finset α), f.pi.card = f.prod fun i => ↑(f i).card

items.name: Cardinal.mk_setProd
items.type: ∀ {α β : Type u} (s : Set α) (t : Set β), Cardinal.mk ↑(s ×ˢ t) = Cardinal.mk ↑s * Cardinal.mk ↑t

items.name: Finset.card_mul_le
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq α] [inst_1 : Mul α] {s t : Finset α}, (s * t).card ≤ s.card * t.card

items.name: Set.encard_pi_eq_prod_encard
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [h : Fintype α] {ι : α → Type u_3} {s : (i : α) → Set (ι i)},
  (Set.univ.pi s).encard = ∏ i, (s i).encard

items.name: Set.natCard_mul_le
items.type: ∀ {M : Type u_2} [inst : Mul M] {s t : Set M} [IsCancelMul M], Nat.card ↑(s * t) ≤ Nat.card ↑s * Nat.card ↑t

items.name: Multiset.card_product
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type v} (s : Multiset α) (t : Multiset β), (s ×ˢ t).card = s.card * t.card
